# Cubo

> Cubo is a private dining and events business based in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, led by chef Michelle Agustin. It cooks seasonal Australian produce in a way rooted in the flavours, techniques and traditions of Asia: not a fusion, but a meeting of cultures. The name comes from the kubo, the simple Filipino hut where people gather, close to nature.

Cubo travels across Melbourne and Victoria for private dining, wilderness feasts and events. Enquiries go to cuboculinary@gmail.com or through the enquiry page.

## Experiences

- [Private Dining](/experiences#private-dining): seasonal menus of 3 to 6 individually plated courses, for intimate groups and larger gatherings. A minimum spend applies to each booking.
- [Wilderness Feasts](/experiences#wilderness): outdoor feasts cooked over fire and shared at a long table in natural settings. Private feasts are booked by a group, with two menus, from simplest to most immersive: Bush Camp Classics and Origins by Fire. Open feasts have a set menu and individual seats, with dates announced on Instagram (@cubo.private_dining).
- [Events & Experiences](/experiences#events): bespoke menus and shared feasts for celebrations, weddings, corporate functions and brand events, from canapés to abundant shared tables.

## Work with Cubo

- [Partnerships](/collaborate): collaborations with venues, wineries, farms, glamping sites, pop-ups, festivals and brands.
- [Consulting](/collaborate#consulting): concept and menu development, kitchen operations, systems, training and restaurant opening support.

## About

- [About Cubo and Michelle Agustin](/about): philosophy (seasonal and local, Asian heritage, nature and culture, no waste) and the chef behind it: Michelle Agustin, a Melbourne-based chef with Filipino roots and nearly 15 years of experience across cruise ships, five-star hotels in the USA, Australian restaurants including hatted ones, and Lume in Melbourne.
- [Enquire](/enquire): plan a gathering.
